notes:
PASS on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/robots/tudelft-cns-atm__bluesky-gym --backend fake (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed (driver.lock.json reviewed_by null); no hardware run. The package serves DescentEnv-v0, the first of the card's AST-confirmed entry symbols; the card's family-config decision and GymnasiumDriver helper express the real interface (Dict observation of four scalar Box fields and Box(-1, 1, (1,)) action), so there is no deviation from the card. One package serves one of the seven registered environments; the other six are not covered. NOT RUN: the sim backend (gymnasium.make('DescentEnv-v0') after bluesky_gym.register_envs()), because bluesky-simulator, gymnasium, numpy, pygame, torch and stable-baselines3 are not installed where the gate ran. The fake backend is a pure-Python analytic stand-in and was never compared with the upstream environment: it draws the reset altitude and target with Python's random.Random while upstream uses numpy's generator, it moves altitude by the commanded vertical speed over 30 simulation steps, it closes the runway distance at a placeholder rate from a placeholder start (upstream derives runway_distance from the great-circle distance to 52N 4E), it models no BlueSky aircraft performance, contacts, actuator or sensor, and it renders nothing. The fidelity contract declares F0 and lists these gaps. timestep_ms is the 30000 ms per-tick period of ACTION_FREQUENCY=30 BlueSky steps at the environment's DT 1 setting; the clone states no unit for DT, which the gaps say. Expected warnings of a Gymnasium family driver: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1 (it only sets the seed used by the next reset) and four G8.NO_UNIT for bridge-derived inputs (seed twice, ticks and the numeric action.values[*]). No G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning was emitted. Only the catalogue classes cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package; gate.digest is the digest line the check printed.
